intro: The Snufflenose Owner's Manual is an instructional booklet from Marwig Rustbolt of Snuff Inc., kept beside the goblin entrepreneur Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet. It outlines how to deploy and direct a trained Snufflenose Gopher to locate rare Blueleaf Tubers buried in Razorfen Kraul.

p: Written by Marwig Rustbolt, owner of Snuff Inc., this short guide details how to work with the company's trained snufflenose gophers. These beasts possess a keen sense of smell capable of detecting subterranean Blueleaf Tubers from fifty paces away. The manual instructs prospectors to release a gopher using a ventilated crate and guide its rooting instincts with a command stick, directing the creature through the hostile thorns and quillboar tunnels of Razorfen Kraul to secure the prized culinary delicacies.
